overview.name: Ramswarup Ramsagar Multiple Campus
overview.address: Janakpurdham Sub-Metropolitan City-12, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal
overview.description: Constituent campus of Tribhuvan University in Janakpurdham, described as established in 1957 and one of the older higher-education campuses in the district. Official pages list bachelor and master programs in management, humanities, education, science, IT, and law.

courses.name: BSc Computer Science and Information Technology (BSc CSIT)
MA in Sociology, Economics, Political Science, Nepali, English and Maithili

updates.title: Admission Open (BBS, B.Ed and BA)
updates.summary: Campus notice page lists admission open for BBS, B.Ed and BA.

updates.title: Ramswarup Ramsagar Campus Inspected by Education Minister
updates.summary: Collegenp lists a 28 Jul 26 notice about an education-minister inspection.

overview.name: University Campus, Rajarshi Janak University
overview.description: Constituent University Campus of Rajarshi Janak University in Janakpurdham. Edusanjal lists bachelor and master programs in IT, agriculture, management, law, journalism, public health and laboratory technology.

courses.name: BSc Computer Science and Information Technology
Bachelor of Arts Bachelor of Law (BALLB)
Bachelor in Journalism and Mass Communication

overview.name: Madhesh Institute of Health Sciences
overview.description: Autonomous provincial health-sciences institute established under the Madhesh Institute of Health Science Act 2077. Public pages describe undergraduate teaching in medicine, nursing, public health and medical laboratory technology, with postgraduate MD/MS preparation reported in 2026.
overview.mission: To reduce suffering, disability and poverty in the province by enhancing specialized health care, research and education.

updates.title: MIHS preparing to run MD and MS classes
updates.summary: Rising Nepal reported that MIHS was preparing MD/MS classes in medicine, surgery, gynecology, pediatrics, orthopedics and radiology after provincial hospital ownership was transferred.

overview.name: Janaki Medical College
overview.address: Kshireshwornath-1, Ramdaiya Bhawadi, Janakpurdham, Dhanusha, Nepal
overview.description: Private medical college managed by Ram Janaki Health Foundation and affiliated with Tribhuvan University Institute of Medicine. Wikipedia and the college site describe MBBS and later postgraduate medical programs, plus nursing.

overview.name: Shree Mithila Ayurveda College and Research Centre
overview.description: Ayurveda college established in 2063 BS under Nepal Sanskrit University and approved by the Nepal Ayurvedic Medical Council. It offers BAMS, including a one-year internship, and operates a teaching hospital.

courses.name: Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery (BAMS)

overview.name: Janak Hajari Vidyapeeth
overview.description: Constituent vidyapeeth of Nepal Sanskrit University in Janakpurdham. Published accounts say it began with Uttar Madhyama and later added Shastri-level classes, with land, teaching buildings, hostel and library. Establishment year is published as 2047 BS on Collegenp and 2049 on Edusanjal.
overview.mission: To systematize Sanskrit education to higher level, preserve and promote its achievements, and produce scholars in Vyakaran, Jyotish and Sahitya.

overview.name: Rajarshi Janak Campus
overview.ownership: private; also listed as public on Edusanjal
overview.address: Anand Nagar, Janakpurdham-4, Madhesh Province, Nepal
overview.description: Campus established in 1999 in Janakpurdham. Its website and Collegenp list TU bachelor and master programs in science, humanities, management, education and related fields, alongside +2 programs.

overview.name: Janakpur Campus
overview.description: Community campus affiliated with Tribhuvan University and also running NEB +2 programs. Higher-education offerings published are B.Ed. and M.Ed.

faqs.question: Where is Janakpur Campus located?
faqs.answer: Janakpur Campus is located in Janakpurdham, Dhanusa, Nepal.

faqs.question: Which institutions is Janakpur Campus affiliated with?
faqs.answer: Janakpur Campus is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and the National Examinations Board.

overview.name: Gauri Campus
overview.address: Bhanu Chowk, Kishorinagar, Janakpur, Dhanusa, Nepal
overview.description: Public campus offering the four-year TU Bachelor of Education, with major and minor subject specializations for secondary teaching.

overview.name: BP Koirala Campus
overview.description: Community campus affiliated with Tribhuvan University and approved by UGC Nepal, focused on bachelor-level education.

faqs.question: Where is BP Koirala Campus located?
faqs.answer: The campus is located in Janakpur, Dhanusa, Nepal.

faqs.question: Is BP Koirala Campus affiliated with any university?
faqs.answer: Yes. The campus is affiliated with Tribhuvan University.

overview.name: Public Youth Campus
overview.description: Private campus established in 1998 and affiliated with Tribhuvan University. Published bachelor programs are BBS, B.Ed. and BCA.

overview.name: Mithila College
overview.description: Public campus established in 2000 and listed as offering TU Bachelor of Business Studies. Some published phone and email details overlap with Mithila Institute of Technology listings and should be verified directly.

overview.name: Mithila Institute of Technology
overview.university: Tribhuvan University; Far Western University; Rajarshi Janak University
overview.address: Bishara Chowk-4, Janakpurdham, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal
overview.description: Private institution at Bishara Chowk listing bachelor programs under more than one university, including BBS, BBA and BSc CSIT. Its website also advertises BA, law and MBS. Establishment year is not used here because directory dates conflict with the school history on the campus site.

courses.name: BSc Computer Science and Information Technology

overview.name: Universal Academy College
overview.ownership: private; also listed as public on Edusanjal
overview.address: Janakpurdham-9, near north of Sankat Mochan Mandir, Dhanusa, Nepal
overview.description: College established in 1999. Collegenp lists TU bachelor programs in education and management in addition to +2 streams.

overview.name: New Millennium College of Education
overview.description: Private college established in 2009 offering TU bachelor programs in management and education, with morning and evening shifts, in addition to +2 programs.

faqs.question: Which university is BBS affiliated with at this campus?
faqs.answer: BBS is affiliated with Tribhuvan University.

faqs.question: Does the campus provide hostel and transport services?
faqs.answer: The campus provides girls' and boys' hostel facilities and a transport facility on multiple routes.

overview.name: City College Janakpur
overview.description: Edusanjal lists City College as a private institution in Janakpurdham affiliated with Tribhuvan University and offering BBS. No further public contact or fee details were found on the opened page.

overview.name: Shree Tapasi Baba College
overview.address: Hansapur Municipality-6, Tilhi, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal
overview.description: Public/community college established in 2012 at Tilhi, affiliated with Tribhuvan University for a four-year B.Ed. program.

overview.name: Vigyan Adhyayan Kendra Campus
overview.address: Tirhutiagachhi, Janakpurdham, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal
overview.description: Community campus established in 2051 BS. It runs +2 programs and a TU-affiliated four-year B.Ed.

faqs.question: Which university is the B.Ed. affiliated with?
faqs.answer: The program is affiliated with Tribhuvan University.

faqs.question: Where is the B.Ed. program conducted?
faqs.answer: Classes run at Tirhutiagachhi, Janakpurdham, Dhanusha, Madhesh Pradesh, Nepal.

overview.name: Central Engineering College
overview.address: Ramanand Chowk, Janakpurdham-8, Dhanusa, Madhesh Province, Nepal
overview.description: Private engineering college at Ramanand Chowk. Collegenp lists Purbanchal University bachelor programs and CTEVT diploma and pre-diploma programs. Published establishment years conflict between 1992 and 2066 BS, so the year is left unset.

overview.name: Nepal Technical Institute
overview.description: CTEVT-affiliated technical institute established in 2005, offering diploma programs in engineering, nursing, pharmacy and laboratory technology. It is described as a sister organization of Central Engineering College.
overview.mission: To find and train students for lifelong professional learning and leadership in engineering, health science and technology.
overview.vision: To be a technically creative engineering or health college and a recognized institute in Nepal.

overview.name: Central Management College
overview.address: Bijay Bhawan, Janakpurdham-8, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal
overview.description: Management college established in 2022 under Nepal Technical Institute Pvt. Ltd. and affiliated with Purbanchal University Faculty of Management for BBA and MBA.

overview.name: Model Purbanchal College
overview.description: Private college established in 2009 and affiliated with Purbanchal University. Published programs are BIT, BBA and MBA.

overview.name: Janaki College of Management
overview.address: Janakpurdham-4, Pidariya Mai Sthan, Janakpurdham, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal
overview.description: Management college established in 2008 and listed by Purbanchal University Faculty of Management for BBA with 144 seats.

overview.name: Model Multiple College
overview.address: Janakpur-4, Ramchowk, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal
overview.description: Private college established in 1997. Collegenp lists university bachelor and master programs and CTEVT health programs, plus +2 streams.
overview.mission: To provide a comprehensive educational environment that fosters intellectual growth, practical skills and ethical values, and to prepare graduates for careers and responsible citizenship.

overview.name: Model College of Law
overview.description: Law college established in 2081 BS and affiliated with Purbanchal University Faculty of Law for a five-year integrated BA LLB program.

courses.name: Bachelor of Arts and Bachelor of Laws (BA LLB)

overview.name: Model Medical Institute
overview.description: Private CTEVT health institute offering diploma-level general medicine and medical laboratory technology. It is described as a sister institution of Model Multiple College.

qa.question: HA ko result published vayo sir?

overview.name: Janakpur Community College
overview.address: Agni Kund, Janakpurdham-8, Dhanusha; also listed as Ramanand Chowk
overview.description: College established in 2022 by Janakpur Community Development Foundation. BIT and BSc Agriculture are affiliated with Purbanchal University, and Bachelor of Social Work with Kathmandu University.

updates.title: Admission Open 2083
updates.summary: Public listing invited applications for BIT and BSc (Hons) Agriculture affiliated to Purbanchal University, with scholarship opportunities mentioned.

faqs.question: What is the duration of B.Sc. (Honours) Agriculture?
faqs.answer: The program runs for four years and is divided into eight semesters.

overview.name: Janaki College for Professional Studies
overview.address: Akshar Vidya Mandir, Janakpurdham, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal
overview.description: College established in 2022 and associated with the Lord Buddha Education Foundation group. It offers a Kathmandu University Bachelor of Technical Education in Information Technology.

courses.name: Bachelor of Technical Education in Information Technology

overview.name: Siddhartha International College
overview.description: College established in 2079 BS at Bhanu Chowk and affiliated with Rajarshi Janak University for BBA. This is distinct from the similarly named college in Butwal.

overview.name: Krishna Medical and Technical Research Centre
overview.description: Purbanchal University health institution offering public health, pharmacy and nursing degrees. Nursing education is described as accredited by the Nepal Nursing Council, with a 100-bed hospital for practicum.

overview.name: Sinha Health Foundation
overview.description: Private nursing college established in 2008, affiliated with Purbanchal University and accredited by the Nepal Nursing Council. Published programs are post-basic BN and BSc Nursing.
overview.vision: Enabling youth of Nepal to have a purposeful vision, mission and goal.

overview.name: Janakpur Nursing Campus
overview.address: Devi Chowk-10, near Janakpur Zonal Hospital, Janakpurdham, Dhanusa, Nepal
overview.description: Private nursing campus established in 2000, affiliated with CTEVT and accredited by the Nepal Nursing Council. It offers a three-year PCL Nursing program with 40 seats.
overview.mission: To provide nursing training so graduates can give quality care in hospital and community settings.
overview.vision: To produce nurses distinguished by the standard of their nursing services.

overview.name: National Human Resource Development Academy
overview.description: Private CTEVT health institute established in 2002, accredited by the Nepal Nursing Council and Nepal Health Professional Council. Published programs include PCL Nursing and CMLT.
overview.mission: To empower Nepal's healthcare workforce by training skilled mid-level healthcare professionals.
overview.vision: To be a driving force in advancing healthcare in Nepal.

overview.name: Valley College of Engineering
overview.description: Private CTEVT institute established in 2010. It ran Diploma in Civil Engineering in Kathmandu until 2023 and is listed as having moved to Janakpur in 2024.

overview.name: Care Medical Center
overview.description: Private CTEVT health training institute established in 2008. Published programs are PCL Nursing and PCL General Medicine, each with 40 seats.

overview.name: Ram Janaki Health Foundation
overview.description: Private foundation that manages Janaki Medical College and is also the named admitting institution for CTEVT certificate-level nursing seats in Janakpur. A 2082 notice invited applications for vacant full-fee PCL Nursing seats.

updates.title: PCL Nursing vacant full-fee seats admission
updates.summary: Notice invited applications for vacant certificate-level nursing seats at Ram Janaki Health Foundation, Dhanusha, Janakpur, after main candidates did not enroll.

overview.name: Nepal College of Nursing and Health Science
overview.description: A CTEVT institutional list and a Dhanusa business listing describe a private nursing college in Janakpur offering PCL Nursing with 40 seats. A similarly named college is also published in Birgunj, so the Dhanusha record should be confirmed with CTEVT before admission.
